name: patient_archive_workflow
description: 建档工作流，如果客户建过档就直接返回档案信息，否则走建档接口创建档案

inputParameters.expression: (function () { var payload = $.payload || {}; if (payload.input != null && typeof payload.input === 'object') { payload = payload.input; } var data = payload.data || payload; var pi = data.patientInfo || {}; function pick() { for (var i = 0; i < arguments.length; i++) { var v = arguments[i]; if (v != null && v !== '') { return v; } } return null; } function str(v) { return v != null && v !== '' ? String(v) : null; } return { patientCode: str(pick(data.patientCode, pi.patientCode)), patientId: str(pick(data.hisPatientId, pi.hisPatientId)), name: pick(data.patientName, pi.patientName), sex: str(pick(data.sex, pi.sex)), age: pick(data.age, pi.age), birthDate: pick(data.birthday, pi.birthday), cardType: str(pick(data.cardType, pi.cardType)), cardId: pick(data.identitycard, pi.identitycard), address: pick(data.address, pi.address), phone: pick(data.phone, pi.phone), marital: str(pick(data.marriage, pi.marriage)), nation: pick(data.nationName, data.nation), country: null, education: null, contactName: null, contactPhone: null, contactAddress: null, orgId: str(pi.hisOrgId), orgName: pick(data.orgName, pi.orgName) }; })()
